seo.title: About
seo.description: {{brand.name}} is a product studio and engineering lab founded in {{brand.founded}} — {{brand.words.productCount}} products of our own, and senior squads embedded with client teams across {{brand.words.countriesServed}} countries.

hero.title: A studio that has to live with its own code.
hero.description: Founded in {{brand.founded}} by two engineers who were tired of shipping software they'd never maintain. Today we run {{brand.words.productCount}} products of our own and build with teams across {{brand.words.countriesServed}} countries.

closing.title: We're picky about projects, not about people.
closing.description: If you're building something that has to hold up under real load, we'd like to hear about it.

_note: The single large paragraph near the top. `emphasis` is the closing part
of the sentence, painted in the orange/red gradient — it is joined onto

manifesto.text: Software is only finished when someone has to keep it running at 3am. That's the standard we hold our own products to, and it's the standard we bring to yours —
manifesto.emphasis: build it like you'll be the one carrying the pager.

values._note: The four principle cards. Add a fifth and the grid re-flows.

heading.title: Four rules we don't
heading.description: Everything else is negotiable. These four are why clients come back and why our own products stay maintainable.

items.title: Senior only
items.blurb: No junior bench, no bait-and-switch. The people on your scoping call are the people writing the code.

items.title: Written by default
items.blurb: Decisions live in documents, not in someone's memory. You can audit why anything is the way it is.

items.title: Ship weekly
items.blurb: Something demoable every Friday from week one. Progress you can click beats progress you're told about.

items.title: Own the outcome
items.blurb: We measure ourselves on what your product does in production, not on hours logged against a spec.

heading.title: Six years,
heading.description: We started as contractors, got tired of shipping software we'd never have to maintain, and built a company where we do both.

items.title: Two engineers, one contract
items.blurb: Founded in London after a decade of building payments and infrastructure inside other people's companies.

items.title: The lab opens
items.blurb: Carved out 40% of engineering time for our own products. {{products.items.0.name}} started as an internal tool we refused to stop using.

items.title: Bengaluru studio
items.blurb: A second timezone, and with it round-the-clock on-call for the platforms we run.

items.title: Five products, {{stats.items.0.value}} launches
items.blurb: {{products.items.0.name}} and {{products.items.3.name}} went GA, {{products.items.2.name}} entered beta, and client work crossed {{brand.words.countriesServed}} countries.
